concentration_time_figure.locator: Fig. 10C (blood); also Fig. 10D liver, 10E kidneys, 10F skin
concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: dynamic PET scans were performed over a period of 50 hrs. Time curves were constructed using mean activity concentration (SUV (g/ml)) in (C) blood
concentration_time_figure.note: PET-derived activity-concentration (SUV) versus time curves over 50 h after i.v. injection of the 64Cu-labelled scFv and IgG4 target modules; blood curve (panel C) is the circulating concentration-time profile from which the half-lives were estimated.

bioanalytical_method: Dynamic and static small-animal PET imaging of 64Cu-NODAGA-labelled target modules (microPET P4 scanner, ROVER analysis software)
bioanalytical_quote: This was followed by dynamic PET scans for 50 hrs, and recording of additional static images using a microPET P4 scanner
bioanalytical_section: METHODS (Bioluminescence and immuno-PET imaging of experimental animals)
notes: Half-lives are stated only as approximate values ('around 1.6 hrs', 'around 39 hrs') with no error term, no group size and no Cmax/tmax; the PK dose is given as radioactivity (~3.7 MBq) rather than mass or mg/kg. Half-life was estimated from PET signal in the heart area, i.e. a radiolabel tracer measurement, not intact-protein quantification. No amino-acid sequence appears in the body text; Fig. 3 legend states linker residues 'are indicated' in the figure image, which is not available in the text file. Tumour cells (JF Luc) and luciferin substrate were also injected but are not listed as test articles.
